summary: Master Value Stream Mapping for projects with our comprehensive training course. Improve workflow efficiency and drive project success in your organization.
lede: Value stream mapping shows project managers and improvement professionals where project work waits, handoffs stall, and rework builds up. Participants practice mapping current and future states, tracing information flow, measuring cycle and lead times, and identifying waste and bottlenecks. They use these findings to prioritize improvements and create an action plan and leadership briefing.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to see project flow clearly, reduce delay, and turn improvement ideas into a usable value stream map and action plan.
prerequisites: Foundation to intermediate level, with a working knowledge of project delivery language, process steps, handoffs, and basic performance measures such as cycle time or lead time. No coding is required. You should bring a laptop for digital mapping exercises and, where possible, a sample project workflow, status report, or process log from your own work context.
